name: Store
description: The license server of paid catalog themes: license keys sold with Cleishop, Lemon Squeezy or by hand, with renewal reminders, activations per site, agency licenses valid for several products, demo and update downloads from private releases; a customer portal where buyers and agencies see their licenses, sites and downloads; partners with their discounts; the registry of the plugins and themes Cleitext sites run; public downloads of free files and anonymous server reports.
author: Cleitext
